items.exampleEn: Dogs seem to intuit when their owners are sad.
items.exampleZh: 狗似乎能憑直覺察覺主人難過。

items.exampleEn: The poet writes obscurely, so his poems need careful reading.
items.exampleZh: 這位詩人寫得很隱晦，所以他的詩需要細讀。

items.exampleEn: The offer was made conditionally: we had to reply within a day.
items.exampleZh: 對方是附帶條件提出的：我們必須在一天內回覆。

items.exampleEn: She perceptively noticed that her friend was hiding something.
items.exampleZh: 她敏銳地察覺到朋友在隱瞞什麼。

items.exampleEn: The professor spoke insightfully about the history of the city.
items.exampleZh: 教授很有見地地談論這座城市的歷史。

items.exampleEn: The project dragged on meaninglessly for two more years.
items.exampleZh: 那個計畫又毫無意義地拖了兩年。

items.exampleEn: Lawyers often deal with the minutiae of contracts.
items.exampleZh: 律師常常要處理合約的細節。

items.exampleEn: Every culture has its own norms about eating in public.
items.exampleZh: 每個文化對於在公共場所吃東西都有自己的規範。

items.sentenceEn: The school has accepted him conditionally until his exam results arrive.
items.sentenceZh: 學校先有條件地錄取他，等他的考試成績出來再說。

items.audioEn: Don't get lost in the minutiae; focus on the main goals of the project.
items.audioZh: 別陷在細枝末節裡，要專注在這個計畫的主要目標上。
options: Ask the manager for more time.

items.sentenceEn: Social norms about work have changed a lot in recent years.
items.sentenceZh: 近年來，關於工作的社會規範改變了很多。

items.sentenceEn: She wrote insightfully about life in small villages.
items.sentenceZh: 她很有見地地描寫小村莊的生活。

items.stemEn: The critic ____ pointed out the weak parts of the film.
items.stemZh: 那位影評人敏銳地指出了這部電影的弱點。

items.stemEn: Good teachers can often ____ when a student is unhappy.
items.stemZh: 好老師常常能憑直覺察覺學生不開心。

items.passageEn: When Ken joined a large company in another country, he struggled to understand its everyday norms. Rules about meetings were explained obscurely in a long staff guide, and he often felt he was working meaninglessly on tasks that nobody needed. Only a fraction of his reports were ever read. His manager advised him not to worry about the minutiae. "You will intuit most of it within a few months," she said. She was right. By the end of his first year, Ken was offered a permanent position, but only conditionally: he first had to pass a short language course.
items.passageZh: Ken 進入另一個國家的一家大公司時，很難理解那裡日常的規範。關於開會的規定，在一份很長的員工指南裡寫得很含糊，他也常覺得自己在毫無意義地做沒人需要的工作。他寫的報告只有一小部分曾被人讀過。他的經理勸他不要擔心那些枝微末節。她說：「幾個月內，大部分的事你自然就能領會。」她說得沒錯。第一年結束時，公司有條件地提供 Ken 一個正式職位：他得先通過一門簡短的語言課程。

questions.questionZh: 經理建議 Ken 怎麼做？
options: 把員工指南全部背起來
每天多寫一份工作報告

questions.questionZh: Ken 得到正式職位的條件是什麼？
options: 搬到總公司所在的城市去住
通過一門簡短的語言課

items.promptZh: 他總是為那些枝微末節操心。
referenceEn: He always worries about the minutiae.
He is always worried about the minutiae of things.
rubricZh: minutiae 表示「細枝末節」，是複數名詞（例如 the minutiae 等）
「操心」可寫，例如 worry about、be worried about 等

items.instructionZh: 用 norms 造一個句子，說說你家鄉或你工作場所的某個規範。
referenceEn: In my hometown, social norms say you should greet your neighbors.
One of the norms in my office is that nobody eats at their desk.
rubricZh: norms 指「（社會或團體的）規範」（例如 social norms、one of the norms 等）
句子要說到你自己的家鄉或工作場所

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：文法錯：a permanent position, conditionally on passing a short language course——應為 conditional on passing…（或 on condition that he passed…）；conditionally on 不成立。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "offered a permanent position, but only conditionally: he first had to pass a short language course"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似時態不協調：accepted him conditionally until his exam results arrive（過去式主句＋現在式 until 子句）；聽打句宜改 …until his exam results arrived 或 has accepted…arrive。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "The school has accepted him conditionally until his exam results arrive."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 demographically、temperamentally 為冷僻長字，demographically 跨課重複（4 次）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: demographically、temperamentally 換成先前課副詞 favorably、indefinitely（「讚許地／無限期地指出弱點」不通）；不用 cynically、inexplicably（可接 pointed out）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: obscurely、conditionally 換成同單元動詞 concur、envisage（can often ____ when… 不通）；不用 speculate

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：minutiae 表示「細枝末節」，是複數名詞（例如 the minutiae 等）／「操心」可寫，例如 worry about、be worried about 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：norms 指「（社會或團體的）規範」（例如 social norms、one of the norms 等）
